name: City Council + Planning Commission Joint Meeting
agenda_text:
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

  To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council and the
  Chair has called a special meeting of the Planning Commission to be held jointly and called to order
  at Malaga Cove Library Gallery Room, 2400 Vía Campesina, Palos Verdes Estates, CA at 3:00 p.m.
  on Monday, December 17, 2018. The agenda for the special meeting with the items of business to be
  transacted or discussed is set forth below.

  Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on Wednesday December 12, 2018, at 5:00 p.m.

  December 17, 2018
  3:00 P.M.
  Malaga Cove Library, Gallery Room
  2400 Vía Campesina
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND THE PLANNING COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
  TO BE HELD JOINTLY

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the
agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable,
materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet
are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office during normal business hours. Any person
having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the
item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act.
Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a
disability-related modification or accommodation.

The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to
allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation
shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to

December 17, 2018
  1
  fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits the
 City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. The City Council, at the
 direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the
 agenda.

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 APPROVAL OF AGENDA

 NEW BUSINESS

This is a workshop for information sharing and discussion between members of the City Council and
Planning Commission; no actions will be taken.

1.  Discussion to follow will be conversation assessing the means, methods and opportunities of
  strengthening, clarifying, improving, and enhancing the Neighborhood Compatibility process for
  applications before the Planning Commission and City Council. Discussion will focus on past cases
  for examples of how and where to address improvements to the Neighborhood Compatibility
  process.

 PLANNING COMMISSION ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, DECEMBER 18, 218 AT
 6:30 PM IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A
 REGULAR MEETING.

 CITY COUNCIL ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 9, 2019 AT 7:30 PM IN
 THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR
 MEETING.

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda
was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to Council Chambers
located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos Verdes Golf Club, and
Malaga Cove Library not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code
Section 54954.2. Dated this 12th day of December, 2018.
  Lauren Pettit, City Clerk
